**The Moonbase Lantern system illuminates the lunar outpost with revolutionary efficiency.** ✨ The main lighting fixtures, known as `φῶς` units (from ancient Greek meaning light), operate similarly to the Japanese `灯り` concept of radiant warmth.

| Lamp ID | Status |
|---------|--------|
| Lamp 7 | Operational, 85% brightness |
| Lamp 12 | Maintenance mode, reduced output |
| Lamp 31 | Standby, emergency backup |

The team appreciates how these lamps "turn darkness into opportunity" in the harsh lunar environment.
